messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a fully playable Space Invaders game.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Player ship movement using arrow keys
- Shooting with spacebar key
- Enemy invaders in formation that move and shoot back
- Collision detection between all game objects
- Score system and visual feedback
- Game sprites: player ship, enemy invaders, bullets, explosions
- Win condition: clear all enemies to advance level
- Lose conditions: enemies reach bottom or hit player
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function createSpaceInvaders(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const W=canvas.width;const H=canvas.height;let lastTime=0;let animationId;let level=1;let score=0;let gameOver=false;let win=false;const keys={};window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.code]=true);window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);const player={w:40,h:20,x:W/2-20,y:H-30,speed:200,cooldown:0};const playerBullets=[];const enemyBullets=[];let enemies=[];let enemyDir=1;let enemySpeed=30;let enemyDescend=20;let enemyFireTimer=0;let explosions=[];function initEnemies(){enemies=[];const rows=5;const cols=10;const ew=30;const eh=20;const gapX=10;const gapY=15;const offsetX=(W-(cols*ew+ (cols-1)*gapX))/2;const offsetY=30;for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){enemies.push({w:ew,h:eh,x:offsetX+c*(ew+gapX),y:offsetY+r*(eh+gapY)});}}enemyDir=1;enemySpeed=30+level*5;enemyFireTimer=0;}function update(dt){if(gameOver)return;player.cooldown-=dt;if(keys['ArrowLeft'])player.x-=player.speed*dt;if(keys['ArrowRight'])player.x+=player.speed*dt;player.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-player.w,player.x));if(keys['Space'] && player.cooldown<=0){playerBullets.push({x:player.x+player.w/2-2,y:player.y,w:4,h:10,dy:-300});player.cooldown=0.3;}playerBullets.forEach(b=>b.y+=b.dy*dt);enemyBullets.forEach(b=>b.y+=b.dy*dt);playerBullets.splice(0,playerBullets.findIndex(b=>b.y+b.h<0)+1);enemyBullets.splice(0,enemyBullets.findIndex(b=>b.y>H)+1);let blockLeft=W,blockRight=0,blockBottom=0;enemies.forEach(e=>{blockLeft=Math.min(blockLeft,e.x);blockRight=Math.max(blockRight,e.x+e.w);blockBottom=Math.max(blockBottom,e.y+e.h);});if(blockRight+enemyDir*enemySpeed*dt>W||blockLeft+enemyDir*enemySpeed*dt<0){enemyDir*=-1;enemies.forEach(e=>e.y+=enemyDescend);}enemies.forEach(e=>e.x+=enemyDir*enemySpeed*dt);enemyFireTimer+=dt;if(enemyFireTimer>1){enemyFireTimer=0;if(enemies.length){const shooter=enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];enemyBullets.push({x:shooter.x+shooter.w/2-2,y:shooter.y+shooter.h,w:4,h:10,dy:200});}} // collisions player bullets vs enemies for(let i=playerBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){let b=playerBullets[i];let hit=-1;for(let j=0;j<enemies.length;j++){let e=enemies[j];if(b.x<b.x+ b.w && b.x+b.w>e.x && b.y<b.y+b.h && b.y+b.h>e.y){hit=j;break;}}if(hit>=0){explosions.push({x:enemies[hit].x+enemies[hit].w/2,y:enemies[hit].y+enemies[hit].h/2,life:0.3});enemies.splice(hit,1);playerBullets.splice(i,1);score+=10;}} // enemy bullets vs player for(let i=enemyBullets.length-1;i>=0;i--){let b=enemyBullets[i];if(b.x<b.x+b.w && b.x+b.w>player.x && b.y<b.y+b.h && b.y+b.h>player.y){explosions.push({x:player.x+player.w/2,y:player.y+player.h/2,life:0.5});gameOver=true;break;}} // enemy reach bottom if(blockBottom>=player.y){gameOver=true;} // update explosions for(let i=explosions.length-1;i>=0;i--){explosions[i].life-=dt;if(explosions[i].life<=0)explosions.splice(i,1);} if(!gameOver && enemies.length===0){level++;initEnemies();} }function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); // player ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h); // player bullets ctx.fillStyle='lime';playerBullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h)); // enemies ctx.fillStyle='red';enemies.forEach(e=>ctx.fillRect(e.x,e.y,e.w,e.h)); // enemy bullets ctx.fillStyle='orange';enemyBullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h)); // explosions ctx.fillStyle='yellow';explosions.forEach(p=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,15* (p.life/0.5),0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();}); // UI ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.font='16px monospace';ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);ctx.fillText('Level: '+level,10,40); if(gameOver){ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.font='48px monospace';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2-150,H/2); } }function loop(timestamp){let dt=(timestamp-lastTime)/1000;lastTime=timestamp;update(dt);draw();if(!gameOver)animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);}initEnemies();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
